question: What mental state must accompany recitation of the root mantra at the end?
premises: The root mantra is being muttered
The action occurs at the end
Contemplation is directed toward unity of the self
inference: At the end, one should mutter the root mantra while contemplating unity of the self.
plain_english: At the end, while muttering the root mantra, one should contemplate the unity of the self.
